The '''Maeltorp Cargorunner''' was a type of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. The [[Maeltorp Intimidator]], a type of vehicle used in the [[BlastBoast 2000]] competition, was a modified Maeltorp Cargorunner.
